steps.npc: Hello there. How can I help you, brave adventurer?
I sell rune stones. I've got some good stuff, some really powerful little rocks. Take a look.

options.text: What's that big old building above us?

steps.player: What's that big old building above us?

steps.npc: That, my friend, is the mage battle arena. Top mages come from all over Gielinor to compete in the arena.
Few return, most get fried, hence the smell.

steps.text: If the player hasn't completed the Easy Wilderness Diary:

steps.npc: You'll need to have completed the Easy Wilderness Achievement Diary to qualify for free runes.

steps.text: If the player's inventory is full:

steps.npc: You need more free space before you can claim your free runes.

steps.text: If the player has completed the Easy Wilderness Diary:

steps.npc: There you go. Come back tomorrow for some more!

steps.text: If the player has already claimed runes today:

steps.npc: You've already claimed your free runes today. Come back tomorrow for some more.
